selection_basis: Adaptive follow-up to the 2026-09-24 coarse MGC landscape. The grid was fixed before this refinement run, but its bounds were informed by prior IS and Validation results.

volatility_breakout.rationale: Follow-up refinement selected after the coarse landscape: daily ATR periods retain the full coarse positive span and add intermediate horizons; entry multiples densely cover 0.55-1.30 around the coarse 0.6/0.8/1.2 positive region. Validation is therefore diagnostic, not pristine.
